children: NEW YORK, NY, Nov 24, 2026 - (ACN Newswire) - Nuxaris faces a December 7 liquidity check across three venues, and Canborsa added two currency markets. Loop opened its shared token list to issuers, while Circle received another validator allocation. Launchnodes launches DamlBo.
Nuxaris faces liquidity check as Canton ecosystem adds markets and allocations

Nuxaris faces a December 7 liquidity check across three venues, and Canborsa added two currency markets. Loop opened its shared token list to issuers, while Circle received another validator allocation.
Launchnodes launched DamlBox, giving Daml developers a hosted Canton DevNet participant node. One dashboard manages package uploads, party creation and Ledger API access.
Zenith connects EVM testnet to 15 external test networks

Zenith connected its EVM testnet to 15 external test networks in a Cosmos pilot, with a test token now able to move from Zenith to Ethereum Sepolia. The pilot explores how applications on Canton's EVM extension could reach networks outside Canton. (Canton Signal Feed).
